_readme: One guided-read session for the e2e tier (WO-A15, deliverable 2).
`input_payload` is the bounded session input the API persists before it
starts the session graph — the same shape
benchmark scenario. Written out by hand here rather than imported from
the learning benchmark so the e2e tier does not fail when a scenario is
re-tuned for a reason that has nothing to do with the graph's wiring.
`learner_replies` is the script. Under mock mode the tutor's own copy is
learner's words are the only input that varies and the session is
reproducible turn for turn. The graph offers four bounded turns; the
fourth is the explain-back that the assessment reads.

tier1.profile_note: Comfortable with linear algebra, new to attention.

goals.text: Read Attention Is All You Need end to end

session_spec.title: Attention Is All You Need
session_spec.reading_guidance: Start with the scaled dot-product attention section.

learner_replies: I want to understand why attention replaced recurrence.
The dot product scores every pair of tokens against each other.
Scaling by the square root of d_k keeps the softmax from saturating.
Each token reads every other token directly, so there is no recurrence to unroll.
